title: Mixing Regularization for Average-Reward $Q$-Learning and $Q$-Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.14988v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The average-reward setting for reinforcement learning is challenging because its Bellman operator is known to contract in span only when the underlying Markov chain is mixing. Whereas existing work typically assumes a contraction property, e.g., through environment mixing, we consider the setting where we are given a reward-agnostic $m$-step mixing policy, and we control the contraction and exploration properties of the learned policy by regularizing toward the mixing policy. We provide finite-time analysis of $Q$-learning algorithms that can be instantiated with multiple choices of regularization, with guarantees measured with respect to the regularized fixed point. Our framework exposes novel regularizer-dependent objects that control contraction, exploration, and operator bias. In the one-step setting, our rates match the best known rates for $Q$-iteration and synchronous $Q$-learning, and for $m$-step mixing we derive new rates. We

translated_title: 面向平均奖励 $Q$-学习与 $Q$-规划的混合正则化方法
translated_abstract: 强化学习的平均奖励设定具有挑战性，因为其贝尔曼算子仅在底层马尔可夫链具有混合性时才在跨度上收缩。现有工作通常假设存在收缩性质（例如通过环境混合性），而我们考虑这样的设定：给定一个与奖励无关的 $m$ 步混合策略，并通过向该混合策略正则化来控制所学策略的收缩性质与探索性质。我们对 $Q$-学习算法提供了有限时间分析，这些算法可以用多种正则化选择实例化，其保证相对于正则化后的不动点来度量。我们的框架揭示了新的、依赖于正则化子的对象，这些对象控制收缩、探索和算子偏差。在单步设定中，我们的速率匹配了 $Q$-迭代和同步 $Q$-学习的最佳已知速率；对于 $m$ 步混合情形，我们推导出了新的速率。
tldr: 该论文提出通过向一个与奖励无关的 $m$ 步混合策略进行正则化来控制平均奖励 $Q$-学习的收缩与探索性质，并给出有限时间收敛保证，在单步情形下匹配最佳已知速率，在 $m$ 步混合情形下首次推导出新的速率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes regularizing average-reward Q-learning toward a reward-agnostic $m$-step mixing policy to control contraction and exploration, providing finite-time guarantees that match the best known one-step rates and yield new rates for the $m$-step mixing setting.
